name: Napuland
storyline: Napuel – The El of Napuland is an epic adventure set in Napuland, a vibrant city inspired by Naples, rich in art, culture, and joy. When dark entities known as the Lutam invade, they corrupt the citizens into arrogant, violent beings called Cuozzi and kidnap Pulcinella, the masked symbol of the city. As hope fades, a witch named Amelia casts a powerful spell from atop Mount Vesuvius, channeling the prayers of the people into a magical lucky charm. From the heart of the volcano, a fiery hero is born: Napuel, the avenger destined to restore beauty, peace, and dignity to Napuland.
summary: Napuland, the video game that will take you on a fascinating adventure through the streets of Naples! Get ready to explore a virtually captivating Naples, full of eccentric characters, rich cultural traditions, and above all, a message of respect for the city.
